title: Recovery of latent inner products from an anisotropic Gaussian random geometric graph
abstract: arXiv:2607.23723v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the problem of recovering latent inner products from a random geometric graph with anisotropic Gaussian latent points. More precisely, for an i.i.d. sample $x_1, \dots, x_n \sim N(0,\Sigma)$ where $\Sigma \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d}$, an edge $(i,j)$ is present in the graph if and only if $\langle x_i, x_j \rangle \ge \zeta$ for a threshold $\zeta$. We assume the threshold $\zeta$ to be chosen such that the average edge density of the graph is of constant order. To address the undesired degree fluctuations amplified by the anisotropy of the latent points, we consider the doubly centered adjacency matrix of the graph, and estimate the latent inner products using a rank-$d$ spectral approximation of the doubly centered matrix. translated_title: 从各向异性高斯随机几何图中恢复潜在内积
translated_abstract: 我们研究从具有各向异性高斯潜在点的随机几何图中恢复潜在内积的问题。更准确地说，对于独立同分布样本 $x_1, \dots, x_n \sim N(0,\Sigma)$，其中 $\Sigma \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d}$，当且仅当 $\langle x_i, x_j \rangle \ge \zeta$（$\zeta$ 为阈值）时，图中存在边 $(i,j)$。我们假设阈值 $\zeta$ 的选取使得图的平均边密度为常数阶。为了应对由潜在点的各向异性所放大的不期望的度波动，我们考虑该图的双重中心化邻接矩阵，并利用双重中心化矩阵的秩-$d$ 谱近似来估计潜在内积。该估计量的均方误差速率由协方差矩阵 $\Sigma$ 的稳定秩刻画。值得注意的是，该估计速率在各向同性情形下达到了最先进的水平（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出通过对双重中心化邻接矩阵进行秩-d谱近似，从各向异性高斯随机几何图中恢复潜在内积，其均方误差速率由协方差矩阵的稳定秩刻画，并在各向同性情形下达到最优水平。
en_tdlr: The paper recovers latent inner products from an anisotropic Gaussian random geometric graph via a rank-d spectral approximation of the doubly centered adjacency matrix, achieving a mean squared error rate governed by the stable rank of the covariance matrix that matches the state of the art in the isotropic case.
